# AI Summoner — llms.txt

> AI Summoner (aisummoner.com) — the product site by Apprentice Conjurer (@ConjurerLab).
> Products: the AI Learning Atlas (free 6-month AI engineering learning map for adults).
> Site: https://aisummoner.com/

## Pages

- [Home — AI Summoner](https://aisummoner.com/): product site homepage with a showcase (Atlas + Beginning of Infinity reading guide + Co-Existence reading guide).
- [AI Learning Atlas](https://aisummoner.com/atlas): interactive 6-month AI engineering learning map (1-day / 1-week / 1-month / 6-month zoom levels). Free. For adult learners, not for kids.
- [The Beginning of Infinity — 18 Nights](https://aisummoner.com/beginning-of-infinity/): a bilingual (EN/CN) reader's guide to David Deutsch's *The Beginning of Infinity* (2011) — 496 pages retold as eighteen 10-minute nights, one chapter per night, each ending on a cliffhanger with a checkpoint. Language toggle: mirror / EN / CN. Nights 1–14 live.
- [Co-Existence — Seven Nights](https://aisummoner.com/co-existence/): a bilingual (EN/CN) reader's guide to Ethan Mollick's *Co-Existence: The Next Phase of AI* (Oct 20, 2026) — 240 pages retold as seven 10-minute nights, one chapter per night, each ending on a cliffhanger with a checkpoint. The agent era's third mode of working with AI is named Conjurer. Night 1 live.
- [The Fabric of Reality — 14 Nights](https://aisummoner.com/fabric-of-reality/): a bilingual (EN/CN) reader's guide to David Deutsch's *The Fabric of Reality* (1997) — 400 pages retold as fourteen 10-minute nights, one chapter per night, each ending on a cliffhanger with a checkpoint. Night 1 live.
- [The Ascent of Man — 13 Nights](https://aisummoner.com/ascent-of-man/): a bilingual (EN/CN) reader's guide to Jacob Bronowski's *The Ascent of Man* (1973) — 448 pages retold as thirteen 10-minute nights, one chapter per night, each ending on a cliffhanger with a checkpoint. Night 1 live.
- [The Selfish Gene — 13 Nights](https://aisummoner.com/selfish-gene/): a bilingual (EN/CN) reader's guide to Richard Dawkins's *The Selfish Gene* (1976) — 360 pages (30th anniversary edition) retold as thirteen 10-minute nights, one chapter per night, each ending on a cliffhanger with a checkpoint. Night 1 live.
- [Conjectures and Refutations — 20 Nights](https://aisummoner.com/conjectures-and-refutations/): a bilingual (EN/CN) reader's guide to Karl Popper's *Conjectures and Refutations* (1963) — 608 pages retold as twenty 10-minute nights, one chapter per night, each ending on a cliffhanger with a checkpoint. Night 1 live.
- [The Open Society and Its Enemies — 25 Nights](https://aisummoner.com/open-society/): a bilingual (EN/CN) reader's guide to Karl Popper's *The Open Society and Its Enemies* (1945) — 920 pages retold as twenty-five 10-minute nights, one chapter per night, each ending on a cliffhanger with a checkpoint. Night 1 live.
- [Bold Conjectures, Volume I — 14 Nights](https://aisummoner.com/bold-conjectures/): a bilingual (EN/CN) reader's guide to *Bold Conjectures, Volume I: Select Interviews of David Deutsch*, edited by Logan Chipkin (Conjecture Institute, 2026) — fourteen 10-minute nights, one interview per night, each ending on a cliffhanger with a checkpoint. Night 1 live.
- [The Atlas Story](https://aisummoner.com/atlas-story): the article telling the Atlas story — "Midnight Silicon Bistro: a small bistro that only opens late at night, and the server is an AI." Reached from inside the Atlas (story tab), not from the homepage showcase.
